capabilities: Import Plaud recordings as markdown notes with frontmatter, summaries, and transcripts
Download attachments, mind-maps, screenshots, and optional audio into asset folders
Sign in to a Plaud account and verify the connection
Auto-sync new and changed recordings in the background
Rename imported notes and optionally write the new title back to Plaud
extras: Early alpha, desktop-only (mobile unsupported until Plaud ships an official API), and uses Plaud's undocumented web API, which may break without warning; the README carries detailed security, privacy, and troubleshooting sections, and BRAT install is documented for pre-release builds.
problem: Plaud.AI has no official API or export path, so recordings, AI summaries, and transcripts cannot get into Obsidian without a tool that talks to Plaud's web service.

relations.evidence: Import meeting recordings, AI summaries, transcripts, and attachments from Plaud.AI into your Obsidian vault
The listing and /ai/transsumm/{id} endpoints were informed by prior community work, most directly rsteckler/applaud

summary: Imports Plaud.AI meeting recordings, summaries, transcripts, and attachments into the vault as markdown notes with frontmatter.
